title: Creative Co-Op 4-Piece Glass Beaded Strawberry Napkin Rings

comparisons.notes: Same full title, Creative Co-Op model DG1623, same 3-inch size and set of 4; store data shows it available at $35.59.
Creative Co-Op catalog name for DG1623, Handmade Glass Beaded Strawberry Napkin Rings, Set of 4 Tied with Gold Cord; store data shows it available at $39.00.

amazon_match_notes: Same set confirmed by ASIN B0GLYVH61W, model DG1623 and UPC 191009815075 by the upstream checker.
writeup: Woot has the new Creative Co-Op set of four handmade glass-bead strawberry napkin rings (model DG1623) for $14.99. Each ring is about 3 inches and tied with gold cord in red, green and gold. That is about $20 less than Arlenzone at $35.59 and Casa Miscellany at $39, and Woot limits it to 3 per customer.
